framing: Pure divergence over the context-governor design space. Goal: surface angles BEYOND the pre-exploration conversation (gauge-at-turn-start, governor-at-seam, reach-up refresh, richer handoff, PreCompact tripwire). Wild entries sanctioned. Organized by design axis: SENSING / THRESHOLD / TRIGGER TIMING / RESPONSE / HANDOFF PAYLOAD / AUTHORITY / ENFORCEMENT+DOCTRINE / WILD. Light excursions only.

ideas.one_liner: Hook injects a model-keyed fill readout at turn start (UserPromptSubmit additionalContext) — the baseline gauge.
Tool-call-count proxy: skip JSONL parsing, just count tool calls vs a model-keyed budget. Crude but zero-cost.
Byte-weight heuristic: use transcript.jsonl file size on disk as the gauge. Dead simple, no tokenizer.
Calibrated self-report: periodically have the agent estimate its fill, correct it with the hook's true number, carry a running bias offset.
Model-keyed static threshold (Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku have different windows).
Work-remaining-adaptive: threshold slides by how much of the spine is left — hand off earlier when lots of work remains.
Cost-of-next-step predictive: estimate what the NEXT unit will consume; refuse to START what you can't finish under the ceiling.
Two-band: a soft 'wrap up soon' band and a hard 'stop now' band.
Task-seam check: fire at a bounded unit-of-work boundary, the natural handoff point.
Every-N-tool-calls backstop (PostToolUse) for a runaway single task that has no seam before the ceiling.
Pre-expensive-op check: before a known-heavy step (big read, subagent fan-out), check headroom first.
Wave-boundary check at Admiral tier — the wave IS the seam.
Reach-up refresh: agent emits handoff, signals delegator to re-instantiate it fresh.
Self-spawn continuation: agent spawns its OWN fresh successor with the handoff, no delegator involved (peer relay).
Checkpoint-and-park: write resume note, stop, let delegator/human refresh on their own schedule (async).
Opportunistic self-compact-then-continue if /compact ever becomes agent-available — no refresh needed.
Tier-specific cold-start block: minimum sufficient resume content differs implementer vs commander vs admiral.
'Expected handover' pre-declaration: when a seam-handoff is foreseen, pre-write the log block ('I expect to hand over after step 4') so refresh is half-built.
The ideas-board/spine IS the handoff: lean on existing durable engine state; fresh agent re-reads it, minimal extra block.
Context-vitals line in every handoff artifact: 'fuel at handoff: X%, next-step est: Y'.
Chain-up authority: refresh flows up the delegation tree (Commander→impl/reviewer, Admiral→Commander, human→top).
Governor-as-watcher sidecar: a cheap dedicated agent watches fleet fill and triggers refreshes (likely YAGNI, but named).
Upstream prevention: Admiral/Commander sizes issues to fit a fresh agent's budget so nobody approaches the ceiling.
Stop-hook enforces the resume artifact exists before an over-threshold agent is allowed to end.
PreCompact tripwire: emergency auto-compact firing = governor FAILED; log/alarm loudly for threshold tuning.
Context as a first-class spine resource: engine tracks a budget line (like Workflow's budget.spent()), gates surface it.
Amend §Universal-posture '/compact opportunistic, not a gate' — OR explicitly fit the governor under it as opportunistic-at-seam, not a hard gate.
Context-bankruptcy circuit breaker: agent can declare itself too full to continue safely and halt hard.
Fractional handoff: hand off only the completed sub-unit's state, keep working the rest.
Model-tier downshift on refresh: refresh into a cheaper model when remaining work is mechanical.
Pre-flight fit check at dispatch: estimate whether a task fits a fresh agent's budget BEFORE dispatch; oversized tasks split.

consolidation.summary: 32 ideas cluster into 8 families. The shotgun's real yield is four STRATEGIC AXES the design must pick a position on, each of which pits named ideas against each other — these are the natural fuel for a compare cycle.

strategic_axes.tension: Handle the full agent (P1/P2/E1) vs size work so no agent ever fills (A3/T3/W4). Complementary or competing — unresolved.
H3 says constellation's engine state already IS the resume block, so the governor is thin; H1/H4 say we need substantial new per-tier handoff content. How much is already solved?
P1 delegator re-instantiates the agent vs P2 the agent spawns its own fresh successor. Different control structure.
D1: amend §Universal-posture ('/compact opportunistic, not a gate') or deliberately fit under it as opportunistic-at-seam. Independent of the other three.

sensing.note: S1 (hook injects real number) strongest; S2/S3 cheap proxies if JSONL parse too heavy.

trigger.note: R1 seam primary + R2 N-tool backstop for seamless runaways; R4 = R1 at Admiral wave. R3 folds into T3.

threshold.note: T1 model-keyed + T4 two-band as baseline; T3 predictive is the ambitious upgrade; T2 a later refinement.

response_authority.note: P1 vs P2 is a real compare; P3 (park-async) is what the top tier does when the human refreshes.

prevention.note: A whole upstream strategy — its own candidate family.

handoff.note: H3 constellation-native; may make governor thin.

culls.reason: self-calibration adds a feedback-loop subsystem; revive if S1's hook number proves unavailable or too costly.
watcher-sidecar is a whole extra agent to babysit fill; YAGNI unless fleet-scale monitoring becomes a real need.
self-/compact depends on a capability agents don't have; revive if /compact becomes agent-invokable.
context-bankruptcy breaker collapses into T4's hard band + E1; not a separate mechanism.
fractional handoff is high-complexity, unclear payoff; park for a later refine cycle.
model downshift is an orthogonal, separable follow-up optimization (ties to no-fable-subagents doctrine).

consolidation.next_move_suggestion: compare cycle over the four strategic axes — but the human decides direction; this is not a convergence flag.
